content: Evolution API v2 instance lifecycle: POST /instance/create (body instanceName, integration WHATSAPP-BAILEYS, qrcode:true, optional number, optional webhook object) returns instance{instanceName,instanceId}, hash (per-instance token), qrcode.base64/code. GET /instance/connect/{instanceName} re-issues QR (base64/code/pairingCode). GET /instance/connectionState/{instanceName} returns instance.state in open|close|connecting. GET /instance/fetchInstances lists. POST /instance/logout/{name}, DELETE /instance/delete/{name}. Global apikey header manages /instance/*; per-instance hash token used for /message/*. Known issues: /instance/connect can return {count:0} with no QR on some 2.1.x builds; only one Baileys connection per phone number.
